scope: Broader source audit of custom DXF CLASS instance-count boundaries and the FreeCAD DWG-to-DXF consumer handoff

method.kind: static source review of local peer checkouts plus Autodesk/FreeCAD primary documentation
method.networkPinning: Peer repository trees were inspected locally and bound to their HEAD commit IDs and source SHA-256 values. FreeCAD main source/documentation is mutable and was not pinned to a commit in this environment; pin exact FreeCAD build/revision before execution.
method.principle: A source-derived divergence is a test/design risk, not evidence that a particular peer output failed or that libdxfrw has a reproduced defect.

LibreCAD_bundled_libdxfrw.workingTree: dirty/untracked unrelated files observed; inspected source file hash binds evidence

evidence: CadWriterBase.Write invokes CadDocument.UpdateDxfClasses before DXF section output.
CadDocument.GetInstanceCount counts matching ObjectName values across the full _cadObjects collection.
DxfClassesSectionWriter emits group 91 in CLASSES before DxfObjectsSectionWriter emits OBJECTS.
DxfObjectsSectionWriter.isObjectSupported explicitly filters MATERIAL, VISUALSTYLE, DIMASSOC, EVALUATION_GRAPH and several other classes.
findings.assessment: Source code establishes differing count and emission scopes. It implies an instance-count mismatch for any filtered class whose input count is nonzero, but no peer runtime or concrete malformed output was produced in this review.
findings.planUse: Treat peer class counting as an architecture example, not an oracle. Count custom-class instances from the complete final emitted cross-section selection after graph admission, unsupported-record refusal/filter decisions, and raw/typed dedup.

findings.evidence: Pinned LibreCAD bundled libdxfrw helper dxfClassForRecordName fills class identity/flags, initializes instanceCount to zero, and explicitly documents that the caller fills group 91.
findings.assessment: Useful metadata shape reference; not a count implementation or output qualification.
findings.planUse: Do not mistake class registration for count derivation; bind counts to libdxfrw's final admitted record manifest.

findings.evidence: Current main's DWG-to-DXF wrapper waits for the converter but accepts output-file existence without checking return code; its preferences select converter mode and C++ versus optional Python import and alter several imported-feature/geometry settings. Official format documentation describes stock FreeCAD DXF/DWG import as 2D-only for ACIS-carried 3D data.
findings.assessment: Mutable-branch static source/documentation review only; no native FreeCAD process was run.
findings.planUse: For FreeCAD qualification, capture requested/effective converter, child argv/status, fresh output hash, DXF parse/sanity, fallback children, exact handoff path, importer mode, and relevant effective preferences. Keep stock FreeCAD outside the ACIS B-rep oracle lane.

implementationReadiness.classCountManifest: Compute group-91 counts from the complete immutable set of records guaranteed to be emitted across ENTITIES, BLOCKS, and OBJECTS. A refusal/filter or raw/typed dedup decision must occur before class metadata freezes and CLASSES is written.
requiredGeneratedControls: two source records of one custom class where only one is admitted; output group 91 must be 1
same record represented by raw and typed routes; exactly one output record and group 91 must be 1
class whose all instances are refused; no stale class registration/count contribution
ASCII and binary output parse-back for AC1018+ instance counts
implementationReadiness.freecadGate: Keep explicit LibreDWG mode separate from Automatic fallback. Verify exact converter invocation, successful status, fresh complete output, independent DXF parse and semantic handoff before assessing FreeCAD open/insert results. Snapshot effective importer and feature-changing preferences.
